data: What is the exact highest accuracy for 'Avg. Accuracy'?

The caption states that the figure shows the impact of training data size on accuracy. The x-axis represents the training size, while the y-axis represents accuracy. There are two lines in the graph: one for 'Avg. Accuracy' and another for 'Avg. Tuned Accuracy'. The 'Avg. Accuracy' line reaches its peak at approximately 92.00% when the training size is 9. Therefore, the exact highest accuracy for 'Avg. Accuracy' is 92.00%.
